posts.text: 🔁Throwback to the 2nd EUSOME Project study visit in #Belgrade On 25-26 November, project partner Institute Mihajlo Pupin in Belgrade hosted the second study visit of the EUSOME Mentoring & Training Programme. The visit brought together partners from project coordinator KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence of the University of Cyprus and project partner the Centrum Badań Kosmicznych Polskiej Akademii Nauk, along with Serbian stakeholders, to exchange views on the future of Advanced Air Mobility (#AAM) in the region 🚁🌍 Constructive discussions with representatives of the Civil Aviation Directorate of the Republic of Serbia, the Emergency Management Sector of Serbia and Post of Serbia focused on the current #UAS regulatory framework in Serbia and the practical requirements for enabling AAM operations. The programme also included a visit to IMP-Computer Systems Ltd., where participants were introduced to advanced simulation and unmanned aircraft control systems, highlighting the technological capabilities supporting future applications 🛰️ Through this kind of mentoring activities and stakeholder dialogue, the EUSOME programme continues to strengthen regional cooperation and align innovation with real operational needs 🚀EUSOME Project partners 🤝:KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence, Hellenic U-space Institute, Athena Research Center, Hellenic Ministry of Digital Governance, Cyprus Ministry of Transport, Communications and Works, Hellenic Drones S.A., Hellenic Civil Aviation Authority, Aviomania Aircraft, GRNET - Greek Research & Technology Network, Cyprus Chamber of Commerce & Industry, Adrestia R&D, Centrum Badań Kosmicznych Polskiej Akademii Nauk, SocialTech Lab, Institute Mihajlo Pupin, EPIRUS - Perifereia Ipeirou, and Mediterranean Adventure Ltd.#EUSOME #AAM #UAV #DigitalTwin #USpace #AdvancedAerialMobility #research #transportation #innovation #sustainability #droneoperations #HorizonEU #HorizonEurope #UAV #UAS #UAM #airspace

posts.text: The 2nd Transnational Plenary Meeting of the EUSOME Project successfully concluded in #Patras on October 8, hosted by our partners at the Athena Research Center - Institute of Industrial Systems at the University of Patras.1️⃣ 🧮 On our first day, the technical partners presented their work so far on the EUSOME vehicle prototypes, the types of sensors to be integrated on them, and the algorithms enabling our progress into autonomy!2️⃣ 🏛️ On the second day, discussions focused on the regulatory aspects for the adoption of #Uspace in the Southeast Mediterranean region, as well as the communication and dissemination activities completed so far and those planned for the upcoming period.Joining us from a distance, Dr. Constantinos Dovrolis presented the newly established AI Ethics Board - ensuring that the autonomous aspects of the project remain informed by human-centric and interpretable amongst others❗️The meeting concluded with final remarks from Prof. George Ellinas, project coordinator from KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence of the University of Cyprus, who summarized key outcomes and next steps. Over these two productive days, partners had the opportunity to review progress, exchange insights, and plan the next phase of activities. The discussions were highly engaging, the collaboration inspiring, and the atmosphere truly motivating for everyone involved.🤝💡🍽️ Of course, the social dinner was another highlight - a perfect way to celebrate teamwork and strengthen our connections beyond the meeting room with traditional Greek food, music, and dancing! 🌯🪕Looking forward to our next gathering and the exciting milestones ahead for EUSOME!!EUSOME Project partners 🤝:KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence, Hellenic U-space Institute, Athena Research Center, Hellenic Ministry of Digital Governance, Cyprus Ministry of Transport, Communications and Works, Hellenic Drones S.A., Hellenic Civil Aviation Authority, Aviomania Aircraft, GRNET - Greek Research & Technology Network, Cyprus Chamber of Commerce & Industry, Adrestia R&D, Centrum Badań Kosmicznych Polskiej Akademii Nauk, SocialTech Lab, Institute Mihajlo Pupin, EPIRUS - Perifereia Ipeirou, and Mediterranean Adventure Ltd.#EUSOME #AAM #UAV #SmartCities #DigitalTwin #USpace

posts.text: ❌ Imagine losing your video link during a BVLOS flight.‘One of the holy grails of AAM’ Christos Skliros explains, continuing the updates of the EUSOME vehicles in today’s plenary meeting, ‘is the BVLOS flight, the safety assessment of which relies largely on the robustness of the onboard technology.’ Presenting the major considerations in integrating computing and sensors onto the Aviomania Aircraft prototypes, project partner Hellenic Drones S.A. talked to us about selecting sensor types based on environmental conditions, and demonstrated how the flow of the data – sourced from both radar and cameras – is practically processed and displayed as detection instances, in the EUSOME user interface.‘In order to maintain situational awareness, the pilot should have a consistent video link. Imagine that link is lost – you are basically blind in terms of non-cooperative traffic. What we are working on here can be used as a redundancy system that still detects and displays other airspace users – this would allow you to land as soon and as safely as possible.’ Our partners Athena Research Center further discussed how this information is brought together in the EUSOME Excellence Hub Infrastructure, focusing on the work required in order to calibrate both sensors in order to be able to project 3D points (radar data), onto the 2D plane (camera data).‘It’s not easy to understand what the radar sees,’ Dimitrios Tsourounis explains, when outlining the challenges of trying to align the manner in which these two different types of information can be used together to paint a clearer picture, ‘we are designing this step-by-step’.💭 Stay tuned on our LinkedIn today and tomorrow for more technical insights as we dive deeper into the technical work of the project!EUSOME Project partners 🤝:KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence, Hellenic U-space Institute, Athena Research Center, Hellenic Ministry of Digital Governance, Cyprus Ministry of Transport, Communications and Works, Hellenic Drones S.A., Hellenic Civil Aviation Authority, Aviomania Aircraft, GRNET - Greek Research & Technology Network, Cyprus Chamber of Commerce & Industry, Adrestia R&D, Centrum Badań Kosmicznych Polskiej Akademii Nauk, SocialTech Lab, Institute Mihajlo Pupin, EPIRUS - Perifereia Ipeirou, and Mediterranean Adventure Ltd.#EUSOME #AAM #UAV #SmartCities #DigitalTwin #USpace

posts.text: Navigating Geo-Zones: Building the Future of Drone Routes in #Cyprus 🚁🇨🇾Designing optimal drone flight corridors is not just about connecting two points—it’s about doing so safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with airspace regulations. ✈️In Cyprus, the Department of Civil Aviation has established precise geo-zone rules, especially around airports. Zone A near #Larnaca and #Paphos is a complete no-fly zone 🚫, while Zone B allows restricted operations with altitude limits and additional conditions. These boundaries are essential for protecting manned aircraft operations, but create a complex puzzle for anyone planning drone routes.Within our collaboration with the Department of Civil Aviation, we are tackling this challenge head-on—mapping geo-zones 🗺️, analyzing stakeholder needs, and using advanced planning tools to propose the safest and most suitable corridors for UAS operations.This is about more than compliance—it’s about building an operational framework where drones can serve logistics, inspections, emergency response, and environmental monitoring without ever compromising safety. 🛡️The sky is open for innovation—provided we chart the right course. 🧭EUSOME Project partners 🤝:KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence, Hellenic U-space Institute, Athena Research Center, Hellenic Ministry of Digital Governance, Cyprus Ministry of Transport, Communications and Works, Hellenic Drones S.A., Hellenic Civil Aviation Authority, Aviomania Aircraft, GRNET - Greek Research & Technology Network, Cyprus Chamber of Commerce & Industry, Adrestia R&D, Centrum Badań Kosmicznych Polskiej Akademii Nauk, SocialTech Lab, Institute Mihajlo Pupin, EPIRUS - Perifereia Ipeirou, and Mediterranean Adventure Ltd.#EUSOME #USpace #DroneRegulation #CyprusDrones #AdvancedAirMobility #CivilAviation #SmartAirspace #HorizonEurope #UAM #Drones #DigitalSkies #SoutheastMediterranean #UAS #DroneTechnology #GeoZones #AirspaceManagement #AviationSafety #DroneInnovation #SmartMobility #AAM #AirMobility #DroneCorridors

posts.text: 🚁The Hellenic Civil Aviation Authority (#HCAA) has published a UAS Flight Safety Information Bulletin in order to inform operators and users of Unmanned Aircraft Systems (#UAS) about safe and lawful drone operations across #Greece.The bulletin has already been distributed📢to over 12,000 domestic and foreign UAV operators in Greece, with the goal of quickly and broadly distributing vital information for safe operational usage. Especially during the summer period, given the growing frequency of wildfires🔥, particularly in forest areas, HCAA advises that using UAVs in fire-affected areas is illegal unless prior permission and coordination with the appropriate authorities have been secured. Uncontrolled drone activity can seriously interfere with aerial firefighting missions and endanger lives.Particular care is also required in locations with high local winds🌬️, which can significantly alter the speed and direction of a fire's spread, increasing the risk to ground and aircraft firefighting troops. 🚨The HCAA has already legalized the use of UAVs for fire prevention and detection, which are operated by Civil Protection at roughly 150 places across Greece, significantly improving the prompt detection and reaction to fires. Within the EUSOME Project, our project partner's initiative highlights the importance of coordinated actions between authorities, industry, and operators as key enablers for operational safety, and responsible UAS integration within the European drone ecosystem.📄HCAA encourages all UAV operators and users to thoroughly read the Information Bulletin and consistently execute the instructions and recommendations being contained, therefore contributing to increased safety and environmental protection. 👇 https://lnkd.in/gBmiGfziEUSOME Project partners 🤝:KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence, Hellenic U-space Institute, Athena Research Center, Hellenic Ministry of Digital Governance, Cyprus Ministry of Transport, Communications and Works, Hellenic Drones S.A., Hellenic Civil Aviation Authority, Aviomania Aircraft, GRNET - Greek Research & Technology Network, Cyprus Chamber of Commerce & Industry, Adrestia R&D, Centrum Badań Kosmicznych Polskiej Akademii Nauk, SocialTech Lab, Institute Mihajlo Pupin, EPIRUS - Perifereia Ipeirou, and Mediterranean Adventure Ltd.#EUSOME #AAM #UAV #DigitalTwin #USpace #AdvancedAerialMobility #research #transportation #innovation #sustainability #droneoperations #HorizonEU #HorizonEurope #UAV #UAS #UAM #airspace

posts.text: 🚀 EUSOME at the DEFEA - Defence Exhibition Athens2025! From May 6-8, we had the chance to join one of Europe’s top defense and security events in Athens, Greece. At the Greek Ministry of Development’s exhibition area📍, our partners from the Industrial Systems Institute / Research Centre ATHENA proudly showcased the capabilities of our millimetre-wave radar technology📡, a big step forward for autonomous sensing and situational awareness in aerial systems. This cutting-edge innovation is a testament to great teamwork within the EUSOME Project consortium, including the Industrial Systems Institute / Research Centre ATHENA of the Athena Research Center and Hellenic Drones S.A.✨DEFEA 2025 was a fantastic opportunity to connect with industry leaders, defense experts, and innovators from around the world. posts.text: ✨ Exciting news from us! Tomorrow, on May 20th, within the framework of the EUSOME Project training and mentoring program for the Advanced Air Mobility (#AAM) domain, the 1st mentoring visit will take place in Serbia!🔹 Led by project partner Centrum Badań Kosmicznych Polskiej Akademii Nauk, this visit aims to assess the training and mentoring needs within the consortium, especially in Serbia, with project partner Institute Mihajlo Pupin. 🔹The first visit will lay the foundation for a strong action plan to support skills development, knowledge transfer, and personnel mobility. 🔹The program focuses on engaging key Serbian players in accelerating the responsible adoption of AAM technologies, including research institutes, SMEs, and governmental stakeholders. 🏢🔹This initiative strengthens collaboration across Europe and supports Serbia’s alignment with the EASA standards.🌍Looking forward to a productive exchange and impactful outcomes! 💡EUSOME Project partners 🤝:KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence, Hellenic U-space Institute, Athena Research Center, Hellenic Ministry of Digital Governance, Cyprus Ministry of Transport Communications and Works, Hellenic Drones S.A., Hellenic Civil Aviation Authority, GRNET - Greek Research & Technology Network, Cyprus Chamber of Commerce & Industry, Adrestia R&D, Centrum Badań Kosmicznych Polskiej Akademii Nauk, SocialTech Lab, Institute Mihajlo Pupin, EPIRUS - Perifereia Ipeirou, N. posts.text: ✨Welcome to the EUSOME Project Channel!✨We're excited to kick things off and share our project with you! EUSOME stands for Enabling Autonomous Aerial Systems through Operational Methods and Technological Enhancements. 📢Funded by European Union's Horizon Europe programme, EUSOME is a 4-year project, dedicated to advancing Advanced Air Mobility (#AAM) in Southeast Europe.🌍What does this mean? We aim to address challenges in transport, emergency response, and climate adaptation to make Advanced Aerial Mobility a real part of everyday life. 🚁With 16 partners across 4 countries, we’re working together to push innovation, standardize regulations, and get the public on board with this exciting future.👇 Throwback to our kickoff meeting, when our journey began at the KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence at the University of Cyprus!🚁Over two dynamic days, our team gathered for the first time, exchanged insights, and aligned on the road ahead.Stay tuned - there is so much more to come!🚁EUSOME Project partners 🤝:KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence, Hellenic U-space Institute, Athena Research Center, Hellenic Ministry of Digital Governance, Cyprus Ministry of Transport Communications and Works, Hellenic Drones S.A., Hellenic Civil Aviation Authority, GRNET - Greek Research & Technology Network, Cyprus Chamber of Commerce & Industry, Adrestia R&D, Centrum Badań Kosmicznych Polskiej Akademii Nauk, SocialTech Lab, Institute Mihajlo Pupin, EPIRUS - Perifereia Ipeirou, N. posts.text: Greece is undergoing a major digital transformation in its tax and finance sector, led by EUSOME project partner, the Hellenic Ministry of Digital Governance! Leveraging big data, drones, and AI 🤖📊🚁, the country is tackling widespread tax evasion and moving beyond past economic challenges.The new high-tech overhaul, at the heart of the system, is centered on an ultramodern digital center🖥️ where algorithms analyze millions of real-time transactions across electronic payment, customs, and bank records to flag anomalies with a high potential for illegal activity. Complementing this analysis, drones and live surveillance feeds 📡are deployed to monitor remote and physical locations—from island ports and restaurants to hidden grain silos—providing inspectors with real-time visual evidence to execute targeted raids. This sweeping digitalization effort has been credited with generating a budget surplus, increasing government revenues, and successfully restoring Greece's sovereign bonds to investment grade📈. posts.text: 🚁 Greece is preparing the National Strategy on Unmanned Vehicles, which was put forward for public consultation earlier this year! This marks a major milestone toward creating a robust, standardized framework to safely and responsibly integrate unmanned vehicles into its national space. The Strategy focuses on four key areas: ✅Establishing clear regulations and guidelines to promote safe usage✅Enhancing security and privacy through measures like secure communication and identification✅Actively fostering the growth of the domestic drone industry via R&D, investment, and supporting SMEs✅Leveraging drone technology for societal benefit in areas like disaster response, environmental monitoring, and other public applications.
